casual_plan.example_text: Pokémon ranch caretaker carrying a feed basket and arranging fresh straw in a sunlit shelter.
casual_plan.scene: A woven feed basket holds fresh hay and a small scoop; sunbeams pass through the timber slats of the shelter as she carries it toward the straw bedding.
casual_plan.outfit: A blue one-shoulder cropped apron over an ivory bandeau and navy shorts leaves her shoulders and midriff exposed, with shell-shaped blue stitching along the apron edge.
casual_plan.planner_decisions: Deterministic planner selected all fields; no manual selection changes.

direct_input_reasons.scene: The ranch-care preset names basket and straw but not their contents or light source; hay, scoop and timber-slat sunbeams establish the feeding task.
direct_input_reasons.outfit: A cropped one-shoulder navy apron, ivory bandeau and shorts adapt ranch workwear to the selected neckline and hem while leaving hands free for the basket.
direct_input_reasons.camera: The image tool has no size selector; Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536) is entered in the generator camera field.

axes_reasons.action_level: Carrying the full basket is a readable gentle movement rather than a stationary studio pose.
axes_reasons.source_influence: The apron shell embroidery, navy panels and ivory layers strongly echo Samurott colors while remaining cloth.
axes_reasons.separates_preference: Apron and shorts are independent pieces over a separate bandeau, supporting prefer separates.

casual_plan.example_text: Pokémon cultural-museum curator placing apricorn balls and historic travel gear on padded display stands.
casual_plan.scene: She crosses the gallery with an apricorn ball on a padded tray, preparing to place it on a low display stand under warm museum lights.
casual_plan.outfit: A fitted navy halter vest stops above the waist, paired with an ivory high-waisted skirt with a long side slit, revealing her midriff and one leg.
casual_plan.planner_decisions: Deterministic planner selected all fields; no manual selection changes.

direct_input_reasons.scene: The museum preset does not specify transport or lighting; a padded tray, warm gallery lighting and a low stand show the step before placing the apricorn ball.
direct_input_reasons.outfit: The vest is made into a cropped navy halter with an ivory long slit skirt, giving the planned two-piece silhouette with visible midriff and leg.
direct_input_reasons.camera: The image tool has no size selector; Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536) is entered in the generator camera field.

axes_reasons.action_level: A step across the gallery with a loaded tray gives a concrete active moment before placement.
axes_reasons.source_influence: Navy-and-ivory tailoring with a few gold details supplies balanced source influence without recreating the shell mantle.
axes_reasons.separates_preference: The cropped halter vest and high-waisted slit skirt are unambiguously separate pieces.

casual_plan.example_text: a ceremonial instructor costume with a belted jacket, gloves, and a decorative sash
casual_plan.scene: The costume studio fitting area has an oval floor mirror and brass rails; she checks the decorative sash fastening before the ceremonial rehearsal.
casual_plan.outfit: The ivory belted costume jacket has a short open back and an off-shoulder neckline exposing her shoulders and upper back, with short sleeves, navy trim, gloves and a gold decorative sash over matching fitted shorts.
casual_plan.planner_decisions: Deterministic planner selected all fields; no manual selection changes.

direct_input_reasons.scene: The ceremonial costume example has no event setting or preparation task; a fitting mirror, brass rails and a sash fastening establish a costume studio before rehearsal.
direct_input_reasons.outfit: The short belted jacket is ivory with navy edges, an open back and off-shoulder sleeves; gloves and a decorative gold sash keep the ceremonial construction recognizable.
direct_input_reasons.camera: The image tool has no size selector; Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536) is entered in the generator camera field.

axes_reasons.action_level: The crouched sash-adjustment moment is a held fitting pose, so mostly posed is appropriate.
axes_reasons.source_influence: A small amount of navy edging and gold sash decoration remains a subtle echo; the costume is cloth rather than combat armor.
axes_reasons.separates_preference: The belted jacket and fitted shorts are independently worn pieces, matching prefer separates.
